DocumentVersionConstraint.description: Version constraint for a named document dependency. Declares the required version range for a referenced practice, baseline, or method. When the referenced document's version does not satisfy this constraint, tooling should emit a warning.

documentName.description: Name of the referenced document (must match a dependency name declared elsewhere in this document, e.g. a baselinePracticeName, practiceDependencyNames entry, practiceNames entry, practiceName, or methodName).

versionRange.description: Semver range constraint using npm/node-semver syntax (e.g., '^2.0.0', '>=1.0.0 <3.0.0', '~1.2.0'). Tooling normalises non-semver document versions before comparison (e.g. '1.0' becomes '1.0.0').

PackageDependency.description: A dependency on another .keleo package. Declared when this package contains documents that reference names (baselinePracticeName, practiceNames, practiceDependencyNames) provided by an external package.

packageName.description: Name of the required package (must match PackageIdentity.name of the dependency).

versionRange.description: Semantic version range constraint (e.g., '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0', '^1.2.0', '1.x'). Consumers use this to select a compatible version from available packages.

documentNames.description: Optional explicit list of document names required from the dependency. When omitted, all documents from the dependency are available for resolution.

PackageDocument.description: An entry in the package document inventory. Maps a file path within the ZIP archive to its Practice Language document type and name.

projectId.description: Required for a project inventory entry; must equal the contained Project.projectId. documentName remains its descriptive name.

path.description: Relative path to the JSON file within the ZIP archive (e.g., 'documents/my-practice.json'). Must begin with 'documents/'.

documentType.description: The root type of the JSON document, matching the schema's root discrimination result.

documentName.description: The 'name' property of the root document. This is the identity key used for symbolic resolution (e.g., the name that appears in practiceNames, baselinePracticeName).

entryPoint.description: True if this document is a primary entry point of the package. Entry points are the documents a consumer should resolve first.

PackageIdentity.description: Package identity and provenance metadata for a .keleo package.

name.description: Unique package name using kebab-case convention (e.g., 'platform-engineering-method', 'devsecops-practice').

description.description: Human-readable summary of the package contents and purpose.

authors.description: Package authors (may differ from individual document authors).

url.description: Optional URL for the package homepage, repository, or registry listing.

PackageManifest.description: Root object of manifest.json within a .keleo package. Declares the package identity, document inventory, entry points, and external dependencies. Validated via language.schema.json#/$defs/PackageManifest.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Practice Language schema this package targets. Consumers use this to determine compatibility before parsing documents.

package.description: Identity and metadata for this package.

documents.description: Ordered inventory of all Practice Language JSON documents in this package.

dependencies.description: Optional array of external package dependencies. Declared when documents in this package reference names provided by other packages.
